purpose: Canonical reopen-condition registry for incomplete Accounting Spine instruments. It prevents repeated source probing or synthetic completion after a scientifically frozen identification boundary. An instrument reopens only when new evidence matches its declared trigger or an explicit contract revision is scientifically justified.

F2.frozen_boundary: F2M is materialized, but F21/total F2 remain incomplete because the Direct-Investment F2 currency-and-deposits subinstrument needed for the exact BPM6-to-ESA bridge is not disseminated.
F2.reopen_when: A source with definitionally comparable Direct-Investment F2 subinstrument detail or an equivalent exact ESA/BPM6 bridge becomes available.
evidence_that_does_not_reopen: broad Direct-Investment debt instruments (FA__D__FL)
the residual gap between known functional components and QSA total F2
historical proportions or allocation shares
missing-value-to-zero assumptions
standard Direct-Investment debt-instruments aggregates without an instrument-specific currency-and-deposits split
F2.standard_bop_iip_route_reason: BPM6 standard components do not require Direct-Investment debt to be broken down by instrument; Eurostat/BNR standard presentations retain aggregate DI debt while currency/deposits are separately instrumented under Other Investment. A country-specific supplementary DI-F2 source or equivalent exact bridge is required.

F5.reopen_trigger_basis: Retained OECD quarterly counterpart stocks/flows publish F512 and F519 by sector/counterpart; S121 remains absent, so only a preregistered rank-equation expansion is authorized.
F5.selective_reopen_terminal_result: The retained OECD F512/F519 rows pass extraction and A/L mirror checks but fail the preregistered 0.1 million RON S1 aggregate-consistency gate (16/44 stock checks, max 1.0; 24/44 flow checks, max 3.0). No new rank equations are admitted.
F5.next_reopen_boundary: Changed official counterpart evidence satisfying the frozen boundary, or an independently justified source-specific precision/reconciliation rule preregistered before a successor value gate; observed residuals do not define the tolerance.
